question: Padma Vibhushan awardee Umayalpuram K. Sivaraman is a ________ player.
solution:
The correct answer is** Mridangam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. Umayalpuram Kashiviswanatha Sivaraman** is a Karnataka** Mridanga** scholar.
 
• He was awarded the **Sangeeta Kalanidhi of Madras** Music Academy in 2001.
 
• He learned the art of Karnataka Mridangam from two famous masters of the art - **Sri Arupathi Natesa Iyer, Sri Kumbakonam Rangu Iyengar and Sri Kumbakonam Rajappa Iyer.**
 
• He was awarded the **Padma Bhushan by the government in the year 2003.**
 
• **On 26 January 2010, he was awarded the Padma Vibhushan, India's second highest civilian award, on the occasion of the country's 61st Republic Day**.
 
• Received an honorary doctorate from the University of Kerala in 2010.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Life Awards of Dr. Umayalpuram Kashiviswanatha Sivaraman**

 
 
• Sangeeta Kalashikhamani from The Indian Fine Arts Society in 1984
 
• Padma Shri from the Government of India in 1988
 
• Kalaimamani from the Government of Tamil Nadu in 1977
 
• Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1992
 
• Sangeeta Kalanidhi from Madras Music Academy in 2001
 
• Padma Bhushan from the Government of India in 2003
 
• Padma Vibhushan from the Government of India in 2010
 
• Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship, 2011
 
• D.Litt from Tamil Nadu Dr. J Jayalalithaa University of Music and Fine Arts in 2019.
